measurementScope: First PrepareDeferred through CompleteAnalysis and PayloadJson after native harness and Item/Player construction. No game, GPU, model or network. Each process has cold, warm-1, warm-2, source-cache-reset phases. Variant order alternates by replicate; process-cold, not filesystem-cache-cold. No concurrent local test/build/collector during these profiles.
memoryScope: wait4.ru_maxrss in KiB, entire fresh subprocess across all four phases including startup/evidence collection, not peak RAM of the isolated cold interval. GC cumulative allocation deltas are not retained RAM.

pack.candidateCatalogScope: Offline source projections for every positive vanilla ProjectileID and ItemID. Projectile.SetDefaults supplies identities; item dispatcher roots depend only on Item.type. No game/world/AI/draw, provider calls, benchmark roster or saved player state.
